_about: Facts the counsel-facing legal drafts must agree with. Compared by apps/web/src/lib/marketing/legal-docs-facts.test.ts. Update this file when a fact changes, then fix the docs. Dates are deliberately not stored here.
_history: Before decisions T2-01 and T2-05, two paid plans were sold: Membership and Membership Plus. Plus is retired and no longer sold; a Plus year bought earlier runs to its end date and then renews as the Membership (T2-13). An employer seat is the Membership at the employer price.
